denominator_note: 3 betrothal-at-well episodes out of 14 major Pentateuchal well narratives

episodes.summary: Abraham's servant meets Rebekah drawing water at the well outside Nahor, culminating in her marriage to Isaac at Beer-lahai-roi.
Jacob meets Rachel at the well in the field near Haran, rolls the stone from the well's mouth, and later marries Leah and Rachel.
Moses sits by a well in Midian, defends Reuel's seven daughters and waters their flock, and marries Zipporah.

controls.note: Hagar and Ishmael at the well in Beersheba (survival/provision, no betrothal).
Isaac's water-rights disputes at Esek, Sitnah, Rehoboth, and Shibah (covenant, no betrothal).
